summary.text: Peter Oberacker is a Republican and Conservative New York State Senator for District 51, first elected in 2020, and the Republican nominee for NY-19. A SUNY Delhi graduate who grew up in a family meat market, he worked as a food scientist and founded FormTech Solutions before serving as a town supervisor and Otsego County legislator. He won the June 23, 2026 Republican primary and is challenging incumbent Josh Riley.

paragraphs.text: Peter Oberacker was born in Merrick, New York, in 1963 and raised in Schenevus, where he worked in his family's meat market from childhood, according to Wikipedia and a campaign-website biography reproduced by Ballotpedia.
He graduated from Schenevus High School and from SUNY Delhi (1983, per Wikipedia).

Oberacker worked with his father at Spicey Pete's Meat Market and became a research chef and food scientist; the state Senate site says he specialized in beef, pork and poultry ingredient formulations.
He founded FormTech Solutions, a food-innovation company, and his campaign website says he moved its headquarters to his hometown in 2017.
Oberacker served two terms on the Maryland, New York town board and two terms as town supervisor, and then as an Otsego County legislator.
He was elected to the State Senate in November 2020 with 55.4% of the vote, succeeding James Seward, took office January 1, 2021, and was re-elected in 2024.

In the Senate he is ranking member of the Alcoholism and Substance Use Disorders and Transportation committees and a member of Agriculture, Finance, Higher Education and Labor; his stated focus is rural emergency services, agriculture, broadband and infrastructure.
He won the Republican primary for NY-19 on June 23, 2026, and faces Democratic Rep. Josh Riley in November, Spectrum News reported.
Oberacker has volunteered with the C.H. Graham Hose Company for nearly 40 years, is a SUNY Delhi Athletic Hall of Fame inductee, and is a member of the Masonic Lodge.

sources.title: Oberacker wins GOP nomination in NY-19, will face Rep. Josh Riley in November
